title: Platform Engineering Manager
summary: Manages DevOps, SRE (site reliability engineering) or cloud platform engineers who keep the company's infrastructure reliable, secure and affordable. Sits between the infrastructure team and the product engineering teams it serves, and answers for uptime, on-call health, cloud spend and how fast teams can ship.
dailyDuties: Hold one-on-ones and coach DevOps and SRE engineers
Review uptime against SLOs with service teams
Run incident reviews and follow up on postmortem actions
Review infrastructure code and architecture changes
Track cloud spend and plan savings work
Plan the platform roadmap with engineering leaders

skills.expectation: Hire, coach and run reviews for DevOps, SRE or platform engineers

Run production infrastructure on at least one major cloud
